description: Turns the corridor purifier off and does not return until it REPORTS off (or ~20 min of retries run out). The miio link drops to 'unavailable' for 20-60 s every few minutes; a single fan.turn_off sent into a dropout goes nowhere and the fan comes back 'on' with nobody owning it (2026-10-01 13:46). Called by automation.purifier_run_after_the_cat_toilet at the end of a run, on an unconfirmed start, and on boot recovery. wait_template, not wait_for_trigger, on purpose: 'already reachable' and 'already off' must return at once. Each new run of the automation cancels this script first (script.turn_off), so a stop left in flight by a restarted run cannot fight the new run's start.

sequence.alias: Retry until the fan reports off
Give the device up to 2 min to become reachable, then send anyway
